tex_content.html:
Given $L<\infty $, let $\overline\delta _1=\overline\delta _1(L+4T_{i+1}^{3/2},r_{i+1})$. If $\overline\delta \leq \overline\delta _1$ on $[T_{i-1},T_{i+1}]$, then every $\mathcal L$-path of length at most $L$ from $x\in {\bf t}^{-1}([T_i,T_{i+1}))$ to $y\in M_{T_{i-1}}$ admits a minimizing smooth-locus $\mathcal L$-geodesic from $x$ to $y$.
Proof

↗ cor:minimizing-geodesic-to-earlier-slice ↗ prop:L-geodesics-exist-and-limit \sketch Apply Proposition 6 to a minimizing sequence.

□
